items.headline: Who could challenge Gianni Infantino for FIFA presidency?
items.summary: FIFA President Gianni Infantino faces mounting pressure to resign after his controversial plan to sell off the World Cup to private equity collapsed. The world players' union accused him of abusing presidential power, UEFA threatened potential boycotts and legal action, and even Portugal legend Luís Figo called for him to step down.

items.headline: 6 Things You Need to Know About the Shocking $12.5 Billion Lakers Sale
items.summary: The Los Angeles Lakers sold for a record-breaking $12.5 billion to venture capitalist Josh Kushner and former Disney CEO Bob Iger, marking the highest price ever paid for an NBA franchise.

items.headline: ‘Spider-Man: Brand New Day’ Hits $700 Million at Domestic Box Office, One of Seven Movies to Ever Reach the Milestone
items.summary: Spider-Man: Brand New Day became the fastest film to reach $700 million at the domestic box office, joining an elite group of just seven movies to hit the milestone. The animated film has also surpassed Toy Story 5 as the year's highest-grossing movie.

items.headline: Alex Eala defeats Alycia Parks to barge into third round in Toronto
items.summary: Filipino tennis sensation Alex Eala defeated American Alycia Parks in the Toronto tournament's third round, avenging her three-set loss to Parks at the Australian Open earlier this year.

items.headline: Lewis Hamilton determined to stop mistakes; Hungarian GP a race 'where championships are lost'
items.summary: Lewis Hamilton acknowledged he must eliminate costly mistakes after his disappointing Hungarian Grand Prix performance, receiving his fourth penalty in three races. He warned that such errors are the type that determine world championships by season's end.

items.headline: ‘The Odyssey’ Sets 20,000 Screen China Release, Including Near-Total Imax Commitment (EXCLUSIVE)
items.summary: The film The Odyssey will have an extensive China release across 20,000 screens, with nearly complete IMAX commitment, signaling major studio confidence in its box office potential in the market.

items.headline: Tyler Duckworth Dies: MTV’s ‘The Challenge’ Alum Was 44
items.summary: Reality TV star Tyler Duckworth, who appeared on MTV's The Real World: Key West before winning two seasons of The Challenge competition series, has died at age 44.

items.headline: Perez Hilton's Sister Gives Update on 'Long Road' to Recovery and His Kids
items.summary: Perez Hilton's sister Barbara Lavandeira shared an update on the blogger's recovery from hospitalization, noting it will be a long road ahead while confirming his children are safe in their grandmother's care.

items.headline: Arsenal's Mikel Arteta surprised by big-money transfers this summer
items.summary: Arsenal manager Mikel Arteta expressed surprise at the inflated transfer prices being paid across the market this summer, while continuing efforts to strengthen his squad.

items.headline: Kylie Jenner, Nick Carter, Becky G and More!
items.summary: Celebrities Kylie Jenner, Nick Carter, and Becky G were featured in entertainment news coverage during the week.

items.headline: Enzo Maresca says captaincy ploy unlikely to work if Erling Haaland was leading Man City
items.summary: Manchester City manager Enzo Maresca indicated that star striker Erling Haaland is unlikely to receive the captain's armband, suggesting his goalscoring responsibilities make the role impractical.

items.headline: McGonigle drives in three to lead Tigers past Guardians 6-4
items.summary: Kevin McGonigle drove in three runs while Drew Anderson pitched four strong innings as the Detroit Tigers defeated the Cleveland Guardians 6-4, with Jo Adell also contributing offensively.

items.headline: DGA and IATSE Push Rob Bonta to Allow Paramount-Warner Bros. Merger With Conditions
items.summary: The Directors Guild of America and IATSE unions urged California Attorney General Rob Bonta to settle his antitrust lawsuit against Paramount and allow the Warner Bros. merger to proceed, citing concerns about prolonged uncertainty for the industry.

items.headline: Halle Berry Goes Braless in Sheer Lace Cover Ahead of Milestone 60th Birthday
items.summary: Halle Berry celebrated her milestone 60th birthday by sharing a sultry photo on Instagram, going braless under a sheer lace cover and showcasing her ageless appearance.

items.headline: Don Nelson memorialized as NBA greats gather for Dallas service
items.summary: Hall of Fame coach Don Nelson was memorialized at a service in Dallas after his death at age 86. NBA greats including Dirk Nowitzki and Rick Carlisle gathered to honor the second-winningest coach in NBA history and five-time champion.

items.headline: Diana Taurasi tales: Untold stories about retired WNBA legend
items.summary: A retrospective on retired WNBA legend Diana Taurasi features untold stories and insights from her teammates who knew her best throughout her storied career.

items.headline: World Cup referee Anthony Taylor lands new role in Turkey
items.summary: English World Cup referee Anthony Taylor stepped away from domestic refereeing after 20 years to take a new position as director of elite refereeing with the Turkish Football Federation.

items.headline: Why have Liverpool signed Barcelona captain Ronald Araújo, and what will he bring?
items.summary: Liverpool completed the signing of Barcelona captain Ronald Araújo on a season-long loan with a €55 million option to purchase, adding defensive versatility to their squad.

items.headline: Hungarian Grand Prix: Lando Norris takes first victory of the season; Oscar Piastri retires from 2nd
items.summary: Lando Norris claimed his first victory of the season at the Hungarian Grand Prix after Oscar Piastri collided with a backmarker, while Lewis Hamilton lost further ground in his bid for a record eighth world championship.

items.headline: ‘Heated Rivalry’ Season 2 Casts Emily Hampshire, Edvin Ryding, Robert Naylor, Sabrina Jalees, Priyanka
items.summary: The highly anticipated second season of Heated Rivalry announced its cast, including Emily Hampshire, Edvin Ryding, Robert Naylor, Sabrina Jalees, and Priyanka, with fans still awaiting its premiere.

items.headline: Watch Ritchie Blackmore return to the stage with Deep Purple
items.summary: Legendary guitarist Ritchie Blackmore returned to the stage with Deep Purple after a decades-long estrangement, giving fans who had lost hope a chance to see the founding member perform with the band once again.

items.headline: How ‘Coyote vs. Acme’ Was Rescued From Oblivion — and Blew Up in David Zaslav’s Face
items.summary: The animated film Coyote vs. Acme, which was shelved and left in oblivion, was rescued and eventually released, becoming a point of controversy that reflected poorly on Warner Bros. and CEO David Zaslav's leadership.

items.headline: They made a stoner comedy together. Kristen Stewart needs a joint to talk about how deep it is
items.summary: Debut director Dylan Meyer's absurdist stoner comedy The Wrong Girls stars Kristen Stewart and Jesse Eisenberg alongside Topher Grace, Connie Britton, and other established actors in an ensemble film that aims for darkly comedic heights.

items.headline: Jenna Ortega’s Sister Reacts to Public Discourse Over ‘Wednesday’ Star’s Appearance
items.summary: Jenna Ortega's sister Aliyah publicly defended the Wednesday actress after viral social media discourse raised concerns about her weight loss, urging others to respect her privacy and mind their own business.

items.headline: Ryan Murphy reveals Jessica Lange’s 1 condition to return for ‘American Horror Story’ Season 13
items.summary: Jessica Lange negotiated a single condition to return for American Horror Story's thirteenth season, with showrunner Ryan Murphy accommodating her request to bring the acclaimed actress back to the horror anthology series.

items.headline: Thomas homers to back Mahle in the Braves' 6-3 victory over the Mets
items.summary: Trade deadline acquisitions Lane Thomas and Tyler Mahle propelled the Atlanta Braves to a 6-3 victory over the New York Mets, with Thomas hitting a home run and Mahle pitching six strong innings.

items.headline: Travis Kelce calls MSG wedding with Taylor Swift 'best night of my life'
items.summary: Kansas City Chiefs tight end Travis Kelce spoke publicly for the first time about his wedding ceremony at Madison Square Garden, calling it the best night of his life.

items.headline: John Cena shares his unique take on WB shelving Coyote vs. Acme : ‘My answer’s not the common one’
items.summary: John Cena offered an unconventional perspective on Warner Bros.' decision to shelve Coyote vs. Acme, noting his reaction differs from the widespread criticism the studio faced over the film's release.

items.headline: ‘Black Mirror’ Director Ally Pankiw Roasts ‘Harry Potter’ TV Series, Claiming She Turned Down Gig: “Say No To Funding Transphobia”
items.summary: Black Mirror director Ally Pankiw publicly rejected an opportunity to work on HBO's upcoming Harry Potter series, posting a screenshot of her text exchange with her agent in which she refused due to concerns about funding perceived transphobia.

items.headline: Cover Story: The ‘Widow’s Bay’ Team Reveals Secrets, Stories & Season 2 Hopes
items.summary: The cast of Widow's Bay, a show with 19 Emmy nominations, revealed behind-the-scenes secrets and stories in a cover feature while expressing hopes for a second season after establishing itself with strong critical acclaim.

items.headline: San Sebastian Adds Jesse Eisenberg, Fred Cavayé, Amanda Kernell Films to Golden Shell Race
items.summary: The San Sebastián Film Festival added six films to its 2026 Official Selection competing for the Golden Shell, including new works from directors Amanda Kernell, Fred Cavayé, and debut features from rising filmmakers.

items.headline: Matthew McConaughey Says Acting in ‘The Wedding Planner’ With Jennifer Lopez Saved Him From Being Searched at U.S.-Mexico Border: ‘They Let Me Go’
items.summary: Matthew McConaughey revealed on a podcast that starring alongside Jennifer Lopez in 2001's The Wedding Planner inadvertently saved him from a major problem at the U.S.-Mexico border when authorities recognized him and let him go.

items.headline: ‘Marvel’s Wolverine’ Video Game Team Goes Beyond The Claws To Unearth A More Vulnerable Logan
items.summary: Insomniac's upcoming Marvel's Wolverine video game takes a creative approach distinct from its Spider-Man series, aiming to portray Logan in a more vulnerable light while still delivering the action fans expect from the character.

items.headline: ‘Warrior Cats’ Animated Series Debuts First Footage, Character Model at Tencent Video Event
items.summary: Tencent Video's Warrior Cats animated series, directed by Rodrigo Blaas, debuted its first animation footage and character artwork at a fan event in Shenzhen, adapted from the bestselling book franchise.

items.headline: Remi Bader Tries on Skims' Micro Teddy: ‘Doesn't Even Fit My Nipple’
items.summary: Content creator Remi Bader posted a hilarious try-on video of Kim Kardashian's Skims Micro Teddy, candidly pointing out the item's impossibly small sizing in her review of the brand's "Fits Everybody" line.

items.headline: DWTS' Julianne Hough Shows Off Bikini Body on Dreamy Sardinia Getaway
items.summary: Dancing with the Stars host Julianne Hough, 38, shared vacation highlights from a girls getaway to Sardinia, Italy, showcasing her impressive physique in a series of bikini photos on Instagram.

items.headline: Jets' Qwan'tez Stiggers in concussion protocol after collapsing
items.summary: New York Jets cornerback Qwan'tez Stiggers entered the NFL's concussion protocol after collapsing during a joint practice against the Buccaneers, though coach Aaron Glenn confirmed he is doing fine.

items.headline: Beau Hossler takes 1-shot lead at PGA Tour's Wyndham Champ.
items.summary: Beau Hossler took a one-stroke lead at the PGA Tour's Wyndham Championship with a 67, while impressive rookie Ben James made eagles on both par-5s to stay close in the hunt.

items.headline: NHL rookie roundtable: Gavin McKenna and other top rookies answer burning questions
items.summary: The 2026 NHL Draft's No. 1 pick Gavin McKenna and other top rookies answered burning questions about their season goals during the NHLPA Rookie Showcase.

items.headline: What's next for MLS with Berg in charge as new commissioner?
items.summary: LAFC co-owner Larry Berg was named the next MLS commissioner, set to replace Don Garber beginning next year amid questions about the league's future direction and priorities.

items.headline: Max Verstappen 'still shocked' with podium finish at Hungarian GP after calling Red Bull 'broken'
items.summary: Max Verstappen expressed shock at finishing on the podium at the Hungarian Grand Prix despite his Red Bull car's handling issues all weekend, noting the team's performance was far off the pace of rivals.

items.headline: Aces secure playoff spot with 83-76 victory over the Mystics
items.summary: Jackie Young scored a season-high 32 points with five three-pointers as the Las Vegas Aces defeated the Washington Mystics 83-76, clinching a playoff berth with A'ja Wilson contributing 15 points.

items.headline: Ureña pitches Angels past Rangers 7-0 as Trout and Guzman lead offense with 3 hits apiece
items.summary: Walbert Ureña pitched six strong innings allowing just two hits as the Los Angeles Angels blanked the Texas Rangers 7-0, with Mike Trout and Denzer Guzman each recording three hits.

items.headline: Blue Jays erupt for 5 runs in the eighth to beat Red Sox 6-4, extend Boston's skid to 5
items.summary: Kazuma Okamoto's go-ahead RBI single highlighted a five-run eighth inning as the Toronto Blue Jays defeated the Boston Red Sox 6-4, extending Boston's losing streak to five games.

items.headline: Logan Gilbert pitches 6 strong innings as Mariners stop 6-game skid with 1-0 win over Yankees
items.summary: Logan Gilbert pitched six innings as the Seattle Mariners ended a six-game skid with a 1-0 shutout victory over the New York Yankees, combining with three relievers on a four-hit effort.

items.headline: Mike Trout leads offense and George Klassen earns 1st MLB win as Angels top Rangers 5-2
items.summary: Mike Trout collected three hits and two RBIs while George Klassen earned his first major league win as the Los Angeles Angels defeated the Texas Rangers 5-2 in a comeback victory.

items.headline: Tiffany Hayes comes off the bench to score a season-best 22 points as Valkyries beat Sky 91-71
items.summary: Tiffany Hayes scored a season-best 22 points off the bench with six rebounds and five assists as the Golden State Valkyries overcame a slow start to rout the Chicago Sky 91-71.

items.headline: Noemie Brochant scores a season-high 24 as the Mercury beat the Sparks 94-87
items.summary: Rookie Noemie Brochant scored a season-high 24 points while Alyssa Thomas added 16 as the Phoenix Mercury snapped a three-game losing streak with a 94-87 victory over the Los Angeles Sparks.

items.headline: Montero, Tigers shut out Guardians without a strikeout, a first in MLB since 2014
items.summary: Keider Montero pitched three-hit ball through seven innings without recording a strikeout as the Detroit Tigers shut out the Cleveland Guardians 3-0, the first strikeout-free shutout in MLB since 2014.

items.headline: Alex Bregman's first career 3-homer game helps Cubs rout Nationals 12-6
items.summary: Alex Bregman hit three home runs in a game for the first time and drove in a career-high seven runs as the Chicago Cubs routed the Washington Nationals 12-6 on Wednesday night.
